title: the one you want
in a crisis?
tag_line: Tag the friend who stays calm when the MRT stops.

rank.line: Makes the call in ten seconds. Usually the right one.
rank.plus: Panic leaves when they walk in.

rank.line: Doesn't move. Everyone else stands next to them.
rank.plus: A human shelter in any storm.

rank.line: Already found another way round. And a Grab.
Gives clear orders kindly. Shares the umbrella.
Has the plaster, the charger and a printed copy.
rank.plus: Ready for things you never imagined.

caption:
Which element do you want next to you in a crisis? 🛟

In Chinese astrology your element comes from the day you were born. Yang Metal is the raw blade: it decides fast. Yang Earth is the mountain: it doesn't move. Yang Water is the ocean: it always finds another way round. Calm, steady and quick, each in its own way.

Find your element free at the link in bio.
